title: Charge a complete encoder rather than postselection
statement: Partition each sector dimension D into full k-groups and complete all remainders into BAD groups, producing an entire source permutation. Its inverse gives T=(1-beta)Id+beta T_bad, beta=E[(D mod k)/D], full diamond <=2 beta. The 384-physical/160-logical non-dyadic example has8385 types and reported diamond<=3.027297624138517e-8; .30sec/5.5MB is a classical table bill. Exhausting58848 small basis states and large exact counts/rank-inverse checks are not dense384-spin simulation. The generic compiler costs about6.93e14 gates/8.66e13 temporary clean bits returned BEFORE storage; a separate1024-spin pair encoder exceeds13million Toffolis. These are real costs, not free noiseless memory.
